100: fun computeAbiFromArchitecture(
101:     require64Bit: Boolean,
102:     sdkVersion: Int,
103:     vendor: String,
104:     cpuArch: CpuArchitecture = osArchitecture
105: ): String = when {
106:     cpuArch == CpuArchitecture.ARM
107:             || cpuArch == CpuArchitecture.X86_ON_ARM-> "arm64-v8a"
108:     require64Bit -> "x86_64"
109:     // Neither system-images;android-30;default;x86 nor system-images;android-26;default;x86
110:     // exist, but the google images do.
111:     vendor == "aosp" && sdkVersion in listOf(26, 30) -> "x86_64"
112:     sdkVersion <= 30 -> "x86"
113:     else -> "x86_64"
114: }

81:     fun createOrRetrieveAvd(
82:         imageProvider: Provider<Directory>,
83:         imageHash: String,
84:         deviceName: String,
85:         hardwareProfile: String
86:     ): File {
87:         // It fails to generate a snapshot image if you try to create two AVDs with a same name
88:         // simultaneously. https://issuetracker.google.com/issues/206798666
89:         return runWithMultiProcessLocking(deviceName) {
90:             avdManager.reloadAvds()
91:             val info = avdManager.getAvd(deviceName, false)
92:             info?.let {
93:                 if (info.status == AvdStatus.OK) {
94:                     logger.info("Device: $deviceName already exists. AVD creation skipped.")
95:                     return@runWithMultiProcessLocking info.configFile.toFile()
96:                 }
97:                 // avd exists but is invalid, remove before we recreate.
98:                 logger.warning(
99:                     "$deviceName needs to be recreated because it is invalid " +
100:                             "(AvdStatus = ${info.status})"
101:                 )
102:                 avdManager.deleteAvd(info)
103:             }
104: 
105:             val newInfo = createAvd(imageProvider, imageHash, deviceName, hardwareProfile)
106:             return@runWithMultiProcessLocking newInfo?.configFile?.toFile()
107:                 ?: error("AVD could not be created.")
108:         }

128:     internal fun createAvd(
129:             imageProvider: Provider<Directory>,
130:             imageHash: String, deviceName: String,
131:             hardwareProfile: String
132:     ): AvdInfo? {
133:         if (!imageProvider.isPresent) {
134:             throw RuntimeException("Failed to find system image for hash: $imageHash")
135:         }
136: 
137:         val imageLocation = sdkHandler.toCompatiblePath(imageProvider.get().asFile)
138:         val systemImage = retrieveSystemImage(sdkHandler, imageLocation)
139:         systemImage ?: error("System image does not exist at $imageLocation")
140: 
141:         val device = deviceManager.getDevices(DeviceManager.ALL_DEVICES).find {
142:             it.displayName == hardwareProfile
143:         }
144:         if (device == null) {
145:             val availableDevices = getHardwareProfiles(hardwareProfile).ifEmpty {
146:                 // If there is no good alternative hardware profiles are found,
147:                 // let's suggest Pixel 6 and other Pixel devices.
148:                 getHardwareProfiles("Pixel 6")
149:             }
150:             val errMsg = """
151:                 Failed to find hardware profile for name: $hardwareProfile
152:                 Try one of the following device profiles: ${availableDevices.joinToString(", ")}
153:                 """.trimIndent()
154:             error(errMsg)
155:         }
156: 
157:         val hardwareConfig = defaultHardwareConfig()
158:         hardwareConfig.putAll(DeviceManager.getHardwareProperties(device))
159:         EmulatedProperties.restrictDefaultRamSize(hardwareConfig)
160: 
161:         val deviceFolder =
162:                 AvdInfo.getDefaultAvdFolder(avdManager,
163:                         deviceName,
164:                         false)
165: 
166:         try {
167:             return avdManager.createAvd(
168:                 deviceFolder,
169:                 deviceName,
170:                 systemImage,
171:                 null,
172:                 null,
173:                 hardwareConfig,
174:                 null,
175:                 device.bootProps,
176:                 device.hasPlayStore(),
177:                 false,
178:                 false
179:             )
180:         } catch (e: AvdManagerException) {
181:             logger.warning("%s", e)
182:             return null
183:         }
184:     }

110:     /**
111:      * Finds the emulator serial with the given idValue.
112:      *
113:      * This is done in a two step process:
114:      *
115:      * 1. Get all serials of the devices attached to adb.
116:      * 2. Query each serial for the id to check against the requested idValue.
117:      *
118:      * At least one serial is expected to have the given [idValue] associated with it. An exception
119:      * is thrown if the serial cannot be found.
120:      *
121:      * @param idValue the id value for the emulator to look for. This is the value passed in with
122:      * the "-id" flag to the emulator command, or the name of the avd launched if no value is
123:      * passed in.
124:      * @return The serial of the emulator that can be used for subsequent adb commands. See
125:      * [isBootCompleted], [killDevice].
126:      */
127:     fun findDeviceSerialWithId(idValue: String, logger: ILogger? = null): String {
128:         val serials = allSerials(logger)
129:         for (serial in serials) {
130:             if (getIdForSerial(serial) == idValue) {
131:                 return serial
132:             }
133:         }
134:         throw DeviceNotFoundException("Failed to find serial for device id: $idValue")
135:     }

150:     fun findAllDeviceSerialsWithIdPrefix(idPrefix: String): List<String> =
151:         allSerials().filter { serial ->
152:             val id = getIdForSerial(serial)
153:             id != null && id.startsWith(idPrefix)
154:         }
155: 
156:     /**
157:      * Closes the given device via adb using the "emu kill" command.
158:      */
159:     fun killDevice(serial: String) {
160:         val killProcess = processFactory(
161:             listOf(
162:                 adbExecutable.absolutePath,
163:                 "-s",
164:                 serial,
165:                 "emu",
166:                 "kill"
167:             )
168:         ).start()
169:         killProcess.waitFor()
170:     }
171: 
172:     private fun allSerials(logger: ILogger? = null): List<String> {
173:         val serials = mutableListOf<String>()
174:         val listDevicesProcess = processFactory(
175:             listOf(
176:                 adbExecutable.absolutePath,
177:                 "devices"
178:             )
179:         ).start()

275:     /**
276:      * Gathers a single path from a list of variables.
277:      *
278:      * This method will check all variables and only succeed if a single variable contains a valid
279:      * value. This includes checking for both env var and sys prop where applicable.
280:      */
281:     fun singlePathOf(
282:         vararg globalVars: Global
283:     ): Path? {
284:         val values =  globalVars.asSequence()
285:             .map { it.gatherPaths() }
286:             .flatMap { it.asSequence() }
287:             .toList()
288: 
289:         // check that the values are the same.
290:         return when {
291:             values.isEmpty() -> null
292:             values.size == 1 -> values.single().correctPath
293:             else -> {
294:                 // Build a map of (location, list<Value>)
295:                 // use the correct path as we want to compare the final path
296:                 val map = values.groupBy { it.correctPath }
297:                 // single content, we are done, return the path
298:                 if (map.size == 1) {
299:                     map.keys.single()
300:                 } else {
301:                     // if not, fail
302:                     val message = combineLocationValuesIntoMessage(
303:                         values = values,
304:                         prefix = """
305:                             Several environment variables and/or system properties contain different paths to the Android Preferences folder.
306:                             Please correct and use only one way to inject the preference location.
307:                             """.trimIndent(),
308:                         suffix = "It is recommended to use ANDROID_USER_HOME as other methods are deprecated"
309:                     )
310: 
311:                     throw AndroidLocationsException(message)
312:                 }
313:             }
314:         }
315:     }
